triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: Contradictory delivery promise outcomes are rejected before persistence and every writer/reader uses one total predicate while valid and explicit legacy controls remain accepted.
acceptanceBindings.note: Covers schema, handler, store no-write, machine, done-oracle, mutation and pairwise contradiction matrix.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: Production test control data cannot select arbitrary filesystem or process side-effect targets, while legitimate env reads and bounded sanitized controls continue to pass.
acceptanceBindings.note: Covers verifier seam migration, production AST scan, negative direct/local propagation fixtures, positive sanitizers, and CLI-unreachable test capability.

note: Two bindings jointly prove the original combined acceptance claim without widening into unrelated evidence schemas or a repository-wide taint engine.
